cells.quote: Empirical evaluations of Wayang have repeatedly shown it to be beneficial both for short-term learning (measured by pre to posttest improvement in researcher-created tests) and for longer-term retention (evidenced by state-based standardized test scores, 1 to 4 weeks later).
